name: xskills
description: Personal skill collection managed as a ZCode plugin: every skill is strictly classified as passive (agent auto-triggers via description) or active (explicit invocation only, with an explicit-only description prefix). Includes a workbench skill (x-skills) that lists the plugin's skills.
